question_text: Describe the role of a DNS server when a user accesses a service using a hostname.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: It resolves the hostname to an associated IP address, enabling the client to address requests to the relevant host. It may answer from cached records or obtain the information through DNS queries.
